objective: Determine what composition, if any, is currently supported among Arcanum capabilities and artifacts, how each material relation is activated and evidenced, and which ambiguities are improvement opportunities rather than deliberate ownership boundaries.
evidence_boundary: Every repository claim requires an inspected repository-relative artifact and precise locator.
Documented contract, implemented binding, observed execution, inference, and proposal remain distinct evidence classes.
A path-specific witness cannot establish a universal integration without evidence of universal scope.
Generated surfaces and historical records cannot silently override their current canonical owners.
No web research is planned because the research question concerns current Arcanum authority and repository evidence.
findings.md must follow the imported DomainSpec research-question coverage contract, including one explicit row for every RQ-0 through RQ-10.
RQ support is labelled only as documentary assertion, executable observation, independent recomputation, or formal proof; these classes are not interchangeable.
No capability contract, registry, runtime, ledger, source analysis, or other canonical surface may be modified.
anti_bias_global: Contract-described composition is tensioned against implementation and observed-execution evidence, then both are attacked for definitional ambiguity, source-authority conflict, and false universalization.

agents.angle: Canonical-contract and artifact-handoff mapping of capability ownership, transferred objects, activation duties, and declared state boundaries.
agents.prompt: Work read-only in the Arcanum repository. Read the validated baseline first. Map the current canonical contracts for Craft, Invoke, Task Session, Decision Gate, Goal, continuation, and any adjacent capability that becomes materially necessary. For RQ-0 through RQ-7, identify owners, artifacts, inputs, outputs, handoffs, activation responsibilities, readiness conditions, and write-back rules with exact repository-relative file and locator citations. Label each result as documented contract only unless stronger evidence is present. Do not inspect the web, edit files, infer automatic integration, or recommend architecture.
source_scope: current canonical skill and spell contracts
agents.expected_output: RQ-linked contract and ownership matrix with material relations, transferred objects, declared initiators, boundaries, citations, and unresolved contract gaps.

agents.angle: Implementation-first and observed-execution verification of claimed bindings, callers, receipts, tests, and state transitions.
agents.prompt: Work read-only in the Arcanum repository. Read the validated baseline first. Starting from the relations named there, inspect runtime code, deterministic tools, tests, fixtures, receipts, task-session results, invoke runs, and session evidence needed to classify RQ-3 through RQ-9. For every claimed relation, distinguish implemented binding from observed execution and record the exact caller, context assembly, result application, state mutation owner, scope limits, and contrary or missing evidence. Treat generated examples and historical runs as bounded witnesses, never universal proof. Do not use the web, edit files, or propose repairs.
source_scope: tests, fixtures, receipts, and observed run evidence
only development history directly relevant to a current relation
agents.expected_output: Relation-by-relation implementation and execution matrix with evidence class, caller, scope, citations, contrary evidence, and unresolved witness gaps.

agents.angle: Adversarial falsification of linear, direct, automatic, universal, and defect interpretations across conflicting source authorities.
agents.prompt: Work read-only in the Arcanum repository. Read the validated baseline first. Try to falsify candidate claims that the named capabilities form one linear composition, communicate directly, activate automatically, share one state owner, or expose incomplete relations that are necessarily defects. Compare README, skill contracts, registries, schemas, generated surfaces, runtime implementations, and bounded historical evidence for RQ-0, RQ-2, and RQ-6 through RQ-10. Record source-authority conflicts, caller-mediated alternatives, deliberate ownership boundaries, counterexamples, and the evidence that would discriminate remaining interpretations. Do not use the web, edit files, or decide which architecture should be adopted.
source_scope: conflicting authority surfaces named by the baseline
current contracts plus bounded historical evidence
agents.expected_output: Counter-claim ledger showing survived, weakened, rejected, or unresolved interpretations with authority conflicts and discriminating evidence.

agents.angle: RQ-complete claim-evidence synthesis that preserves dissent and keeps present behavior separate from later improvement judgment.
agents.prompt: After all explorer returns or typed partial failures are joined, preserve the returns verbatim in research.md and produce findings.md using the binding findings-template.md imported from DomainSpec. Place Research-question coverage before the candidate matrix. Include exactly one row for every RQ-0 through RQ-10 with columns RQ id, status, answer, addressable evidence, contrary evidence / material uncertainty, and boundary. Status is only answered, unresolved, deferred, or retired. Label support only as documentary assertion, executable observation, independent recomputation, or formal proof. Cite original sources and stable return IDs; never infer absence from failure to find evidence. Then evaluate the six candidate claim families with owner, witnessed, sound, verdict, and use-mode; preserve dissent, reversals, authority conflicts, limitations, and typed negatives. End with the one-line answer to RQ-0. Do not edit analysis.md or any source artifact, and do not convert improvement implications into implementation decisions.
source_scope: joined explorer returns and their cited repository sources only
agents.expected_output: research.md plus findings.md conforming exactly to the imported DomainSpec RQ-coverage contract

agents.angle: Definitional-soundness gate for communication, composition, relation, ownership, readiness, state, and improvement-boundary claims.
agents.prompt: Attack only the definitional-soundness gate. Verify that every load-bearing term is operationally bounded by current Arcanum authority, that the RQ-0 answer does not assume one linear or universal composition, and that direct, caller-mediated, automatic, intended, implemented, and observed relations are not collapsed. Also verify that each findings row uses only the four allowed statuses and that an answered row resolves the entire RQ in scope. Return PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK with exact repairs. Do not introduce new research or edit artifacts.
source_scope: research.md, findings.md, and repository sources already cited by the synthesis
agents.expected_output: Definitional-soundness verdict with exact ambiguous, circular, overbroad, or category-collapsing claims.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity and evidence-authority gate for relation witnesses, source precedence, negative findings, and scope of inference.
agents.prompt: Attack only the non-vacuity and evidence-authority gate. Verify that every RQ-0 through RQ-10 has exactly one findings row; every positive answer cites addressable evidence; support uses only documentary assertion, executable observation, independent recomputation, or formal proof; unresolved rows name inspected material, attempted checks, and the exact residual gap; source conflicts are not silently resolved; and missing universal binding is not automatically called a defect. Return PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK with exact repairs. Do not add new research or edit artifacts.
source_scope: research.md, findings.md, cited repository evidence, and candidate verdict table
agents.expected_output: Evidence-authority verdict identifying unsupported, vacuous, misclassified, overgeneralized, or authority-conflicted findings.

agents.angle: Final RQ coverage, citation, dissent, evidence-class, boundary, and verdict audit.
agents.prompt: Read research.md, findings.md, findings-template.md, both skeptic verdicts, and any single bounded writer revision. Check exact conformance to the imported DomainSpec contract: one row each for RQ-0 through RQ-10 before the candidate matrix; only answered, unresolved, deferred, or retired; exact original-source citations; evidence labelled documentary assertion, executable observation, independent recomputation, or formal proof; contrary evidence or uncertainty and boundary in every row; no positive answer without evidence; unresolved rows naming the residual gap. Also check candidate verdicts, preserved dissent, limitations, one-line RQ-0 answer, and absence of source mutation or implementation authority. Return ACCEPT or REJECT with specific residue. Do not edit artifacts.
source_scope: final research artifacts, skeptic verdicts, and cited repository evidence
agents.expected_output: Independent audit verdict for the parent final approver.

groups.purpose: Establish contract, implementation, observed-execution, counterexample, and authority evidence in parallel.

predicted_disagreements.sentence: contract-ownership-cartographer runs canonical-contract and declared-handoff mapping, while runtime-witness-verifier runs implementation and observed-execution verification on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias internal to treating declared composition as executed would be exposed by runtime-witness-verifier.

contract-ownership-cartographer runs owner-and-relation reconstruction, while authority-boundary-falsifier runs counterexample and source-conflict attacks on the methodology axis; a bias internal to reading adjacent contracts as direct or universal integration would be exposed by authority-boundary-falsifier.

runtime-witness-verifier runs concrete binding and execution-witness inspection, while authority-boundary-falsifier runs path-specificity and false-universalization attacks on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias internal to generalizing one observed route would be exposed by authority-boundary-falsifier.

groups.purpose: Join evidence into per-RQ findings without erasing dissent or evidence-class boundaries.
Apply distinct definitional-soundness and evidence-authority gates in parallel.

predicted_disagreements.sentence: definition-scope-skeptic runs a definitional and category-boundary attack, while evidence-authority-skeptic runs a non-vacuity, witness, and source-precedence attack on the attack-vector axis; a bias internal to semantic coherence would be exposed by evidence-authority-skeptic, while a bias internal to evidential sufficiency would be exposed by definition-scope-skeptic.

groups.purpose: Independently audit the final research package for parent approval.

preparation for bounded Task Session execution

in-scope capabilities, ownership, material relations, and transferred objects
relation activation, coordination, and preparation for bounded execution

evidential status and governing source authority for every claimed relation
material improvement gaps versus deliberate ownership boundaries

stage_handoff_rules: Synthesis waits for all three explorer returns or typed partial failures with explicit confidence limits.
Skeptics wait for both research.md and findings.md and complete RQ-0 through RQ-10 coverage.
At most one writer revision may answer typed skeptic defects.
Audit waits for both skeptic verdicts and any admitted writer revision.

forbidden_evidence: credentials, tokens, personal data, or secrets
machine-specific absolute paths in published findings
uncited recollection presented as repository evidence
external precedent presented as current Arcanum authority

validation: research-initial-definitions validator remains pass at the admitted SHA-256
the binding findings-template.md remains present at its admitted SHA-256
findings.md places Research-question coverage before the candidate verdict matrix
findings.md contains exactly one row for every RQ-0 through RQ-10
each RQ status is only answered, unresolved, deferred, or retired
every positive answer cites addressable original-source evidence
evidence support is labelled only documentary assertion, executable observation, independent recomputation, or formal proof
every unresolved row names inspected material, attempted checks, and the exact residual gap
every repository claim cites an inspected repository-relative file and precise locator
documented contract, implemented binding, observed execution, inference, and proposal remain distinct
research.md preserves all explorer returns verbatim for the multi-agent run
findings.md contains candidate verdicts, conclusions, implications, dissent, limitations, and the one-line RQ-0 answer
both skeptic gates and the final audit pass before parent approval
stop_conditions: Stop before launch if the revised baseline, findings template, composite confirmation readiness, or either independent tension checker does not pass.
Stop repository exploration when every RQ has bounded evidence or a typed unresolved gap; do not expand into unrelated Arcanum history.
Stop downstream stages on missing required returns unless a typed partial failure preserves bounded synthesis with an explicit confidence limit.
Stop after one writer revision loop and propagate remaining disagreement.
Do not browse the web, implement changes, revise analysis.md, mutate source artifacts, or write outside the confirmed working folder.

required_section_order: One-line answer to the research goal
